## Goal
Make the checkout flow resilient to payment provider timeouts and double submits.

## Scope
- Add idempotency keys to every order creation call.
- Retry provider calls with exponential backoff.
- Show a single clear error state in the UI.
- Do not touch the catalog service.

## Quality bar
1. Every new path has a unit test.
2. The integration test suite stays green.
3. No new dependency without a note in the design doc.

## Deliverables
- A pull request against the working branch.
- A short write-up of the failure modes covered.

## Reporting
Report what changed, what was verified, and what remains open.
